shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "find .. -name AGENTS.md -print && git diff -- package.json && cat package.json && cat next.config.ts && sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,240p' app/news/page.tsx && sed -n '1,240p' app/preview/page.tsx && sed -n '1,200p' app/layout.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "git switch -c cache-components-migration && rg -n \"dynamicIO|cacheComponents|force-dynamic|revalidate|noStore|unstable_noStore|use cache|cacheLife\" --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' . && node -p \"require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version\" && rg -n \"export.*cacheLife|function cacheLife|type CacheLife\" node_modules/next/dist/server/use-cache/cache-life.d.ts node_modules/next/cache.d.ts node_modules/next/dist -g '*.d.ts' | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"cookies\\(\\)|Request-time APIs|Suspense\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating-to-cache-components.md | head -40 && sed -n '450,610p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating-to-cache-components.md && rg -n \"Cache Components.*cookies|cookies\\(\\).*Suspense|blocking prerender.*cookies\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/cookies.md | head -50"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check && git diff -- next.config.ts app/news/page.tsx app/preview/page.tsx && rg -n \"dynamicIO|force-dynamic|export const (dynamic|revalidate|fetchCache)|instant\\s*=\\s*false|unstable_noStore|noStore\" app next.config.ts"
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short --branch && git diff -- tsconfig.json package.json && git diff --check'

/bin/bash -lc "git restore tsconfig.json && git clean -fd -- .next next-env.d.ts && git status --short --branch && git diff --check && (rg -n \"dynamicIO|force-dynamic|export const (dynamic|revalidate|fetchCache)|instant\\s*=\\s*false|unstable_noStore|noStore\" app next.config.ts || true) && git diff --stat && git diff -- app/news/page.tsx app/preview/page.tsx next.config.ts"
